source: Replace with where these numbers come from, e.g. 'Assignment brief, NFR doc v1'

_help.metrics: avg_ms, p90_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, max_ms (upper limits); error_rate_pct (upper limit, percent); throughput_rps_min (lower limit, requests per second)
_help.defaults: applied to every sampler label; a 'samplers' entry overrides individual metrics for that label
_help.samplers: keys must match the sampler label exactly as it appears in the .jtl
_help.total: checked against the TOTAL row only
_help.placeholder: set to false once the values are agreed; while true the report flags them as unagreed
